notes: *The time* is `added` (rules 17, 30): לֹא בְקָרוֹב has no nominal for it, and rule 20 supplies only a copula, never a lexical subject.
הִיא takes the whole lexical expression *this city* under rule 20's "the English pronoun or noun realizing it", while the copula *is* joins the written predicate סִיר.

The copula of לֹא בְקָרוֹב is placed on בְ as the head of the prepositional predicate (rule 49). The competing reading leaves בְ `unrepresented` under rule 40 and puts *is* on the predicate adjective קָרוֹב under rule 20; the accepted reading stands because בְקָרוֹב is the clause's predicate and rule 49 treats that placement as settled.
